label: impediment
definition: Anything that stops a wave: a red gate, a merge conflict, a missing label, a failing check, a question the plan does not answer. The captain removes every impediment itself. Only the four genuine blockers of issue-lifecycle.md section 2 reach the owner; a red gate is an impediment, not a blocker.
is_not: A genuine blocker: a blocker is one of the four impediments that need the owner; every other impediment the captain removes.
A loose issue: a loose issue is an open issue with no home; it may cause no stop at all.
A risk: a risk may stop the wave later; an impediment stops it now.
